title: cardamine pratensis var. dentata
intro: Cardamine pratensis var. dentata, commonly known as the toothed lesser celandine, is a perennial plant species within the Brassicaceae family. The plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Cardamine pratensis var. dentata include its ability to stimulate digestion, calm the nervous system, and act as a mild diuretic. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
